Point of view -- whose network I am looking through.
Context -- which slice of it. Family, here.
And a tag, to narrow it to one subject.

I vouched for Tom. Tom vouched for Hillel.
The proof is a chain of signatures, there to check.
The same identity, carried to another service.

And refused. HabloTengo grounds itself in the same open network
to keep things private, not only authentic.

Refusing is the point.
Authentic does not mean public.
